_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Daytona Beach. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Daytona Lagoon
deals.deal: $30 Fun Card for $20; $200 Arcade Card for $100, through Dec 31
deals.details: The $30 card can be used across the Family Entertainment Center, including attraction bands and arcade games. The $200-for-$100 arcade card is listed at 50% off.

deals.name: Daytona Lagoon
deals.deal: 2027 Season Pass $69.99 (reg. $129.99), Black Friday sale through Nov 29
deals.details: Pass covers unlimited waterpark access, go-karts, laser tag, mini golf, bumper cars and more, plus one free one-time Buddy Ticket and $10 arcade credit. Open to the public from Nov 25, 2026; ends Nov 29, 2026.

deals.name: Marine Science Center
deals.deal: Free general admission for U.S. military veterans
deals.details: Free individual general admission applies to the veteran only, not additional guests. Regular admission is $8 adults, $7 seniors 50+, $5 youth 3-12; closed Mondays.

deals.name: Ponce de Leon Inlet Lighthouse & Museum
deals.deal: 20% off admission for active-duty and former military
deals.details: Discount requires proof of service and does not extend to dependents or others in the party. Lighthouse admission is $6.95 adults, $1.95 children 3-11.

deals.name: Ponce de Leon Inlet Lighthouse & Museum
deals.deal: Free admission for Ponce Inlet residents
deals.details: Ponce Inlet residents get free admission to both the Lighthouse Museum and the Pacetti Hotel Museum with proof of residency.

deals.name: Chart House
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 4-6:30 PM: $6 wells, $8 glass wines, $9 cocktails, bites from $8
deals.details: Happy hour menu also lists $8 premium spirits, $10 premium wines and draft beers at $4.50 and $5.25, with bites at $8 to $14.

deals.name: Clancy's Cantina
deals.deal: Happy hour daily until 6:30 PM: $5 Cantina Ritas, $5 wells, $6 house wines
deals.details: Happy hour also includes $2 off specialty margaritas and $1 off beers.

deals.name: Clancy's Cantina
deals.deal: Thursday ladies' night: half-off drinks in the bar
deals.details: Every Thursday in the bar, with live music and food specials.

deals.name: Hyde Park Prime Steakhouse
deals.deal: Bar happy hour Mon-Fri 4-6 PM: martinis, cocktails and bar plates from $7
deals.details: Happy hour is in the bar only and is not offered on holidays.
deals.location: Hilton Daytona Beach Oceanfront · 100 N Atlantic Ave

deals.name: Norwood's Restaurant & Treehouse Bar
deals.deal: $5 house wine, domestic beer and wells, Mon-Fri 4-6 PM
deals.details: Also $6 craft beer, call drinks and premium wines, and $9 specialty cocktails. Late-night happy hour Sun-Thu 8 PM to close in the Treehouse only; not offered on holidays.

deals.name: Salty Rim Bar & Grill
deals.details: Happy hour at the bar and grill at the Compass Hotel, Monday through Friday from 3 to 5 PM.

deals.name: Sessions Restaurant (Hard Rock Hotel Daytona Beach)
deals.deal: Happy hour Sun-Thu 3-6 PM; late-night happy-hour drinks Sun-Fri 10 PM-close
deals.details: Happy hour offers specially priced food and drinks. Liquid Encore serves happy-hour-priced drinks Sunday through Friday from 10 PM to close.
deals.location: Hard Rock Hotel · 918 N Atlantic Ave

deals.name: The Shores Resort & Spa
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 3-6 PM on cocktails, beer, wine and select appetizers
deals.details: After happy hour, games at the Cosmic Sands Arcade upstairs are 50% off. All restaurants and bars are cashless.
deals.location: Daytona Beach Shores · 2637 S Atlantic Ave

deals.name: BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse
deals.deal: Half-off mini deep dish pizzas and select apps + $4-$5 drinks, Mon-Fri 3-7 PM
deals.details: Happy hour also runs Sun-Thu 9 PM to close in the bar and patio only. Includes $4 domestic bottles, $5 house beers, call drinks and margaritas; food discount excludes tri-tip sliders and wings.
deals.location: Daytona Beach · 2514 W International Speedway Blvd

deals.name: Chart House

deals.details: The early dining menu offers six entrees priced from $23 to $35.

deals.details: The Original Oyster Happy Hour runs Saturday and Sunday at the New Smyrna Beach location.

deals.name: The Shores Resort & Spa
deals.details: The resort offers veterans 25% off dining at its restaurants.
